title: The Radiators of the coast road
author: Ansel Zhou
blurb: Sebastian Quintana, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
